description: Check EU/international alignment status for a South African statute or provision. Detects references to international instruments and reports alignment status: aligned, partial, unclear, or not_applicable. Note: South Africa is not an EU member — this tracks influence and voluntary alignment, not legal obligation.

eu_document_id.description: Optional: check alignment with a specific international document (e.g., "regulation:2016/679")

name: validate_eu_compliance
